pre-equilibrium.alt: Step 1 is drawn with a pair of arrows: A plus B forms the intermediate I at rate k1 times [A] times [B], and I falls back to A plus B at rate k-1 times [I]. Both are fast and equal. Step 2, slow: I plus C forms products at rate k2 times [I] times [C]. Below, setting the two step 1 rates equal gives [I] equal to k1 over k-1 times [A][B]; substituting into the slow step gives rate equals k2 k1 over k-1 times [A][B][C].
